recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No current FHIR core source change is needed for FHIR-11307; future genomics resource changes should follow the active MolecularDefinition/Molecular Data Types issue trail rather than reopening this DSTU2 Sequence wording correction.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics correction against the DSTU2 Sequence resource asking to fix wording that implied Sequence could only describe one variant; the resolution said this was a typo because Sequence can have multiple variants.
initial_application: Git commit 54e60c59aa7079e0f7bf544e617b09edc183060c, '#11307 Revise introduction on Sequence resource page,' changed source/sequence/sequence-introduction.xml from 'at most one variation' and 'a sequence variation' to wording about 'multiple variations' and 'sequence variations.'
additional_context: Later source history renamed Sequence to MolecularSequence for FHIR-19453, and the current fhir.ini no longer has Sequence, MolecularSequence, or MolecularDefinition as active [resources] entries. Sequence is listed under [removed-resources], MolecularSequence is only present in inactive/commented or historical metadata, and the remaining MolecularDefinition source prose inspected in the checkout does not preserve the old single-variation limitation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the accepted historical correction is already present in history, the original resource is out of current build scope, and exact source searches found no remaining old wording to fix.
